DEMURRER to COMPLAINT
Off Calendar Aug-20-2026 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: APPEARANCES:

Hripsime Martirosyan; 818-714-0655; Block LLP; counsel for plaintiff appearing via Zoom.
Michael Cohen; 424-431-1990; Segal Mccambridge Singer & Mahoney, LTD; counsel appearing for defendant via Zoom.

Mr. Cohen contests the courts tentative ruling. Discussed. After reviewing the pleadings and having discussions with the Court, the Court adopts the tentative ruling as follows:

DEFENDANT THE WARRIOR ROOSTER, LLC DEMURRER to COMPLAINT is OVERRULED, 10 days to answer. On a demurrer allegations of ultimate facts must be taken as true. Nothing on the face of Ex. A attached to the complaint, providing for use of the premises by 3 persons, contradicts the allegations in the complaint that both Plaintiffs are tenants under the law. Additionally, causes of action for IIED, Nuisance and failure to provide habitable premises under the statutory standards of habitability are sufficiently stated. See Green v. Sup. Ct (1974) 10 Cal.3d 616; Stoiber v. Honeychuck (1980) 101 Cal.App.3d 903.

Prevailing party to submit a proposed order that in compliance with CRC 3.1312(b)
